_purpose: Ceiling on the number of Tier 2 scratch files carrying an untriaged LESSON. scripts/enforcement/memory-promotion-gate.mjs fails when the backlog grows past this. Capture is never blocked; the planner must triage at least as fast as lessons arrive.
_howToChange: LOWER it in the same commit that records triage decisions in _catalog/memory_promotion_log.jsonl. Never RAISE it to make a red build green — that converts an unworked backlog into a specification.
_whyThisNumberToday: The fleet memory promotion step had never run once. The 2026-08-08 memory system audit found the L3 grading rung executed zero times in 215 sessions. This pin is the backlog as measured on 2026-08-20, so the gate starts honest rather than red-on-arrival.
